title: Shark is the only vacuum I will buy
text:
Shark is the only vacuum I will buy. I have owned a lot of different brand vacuum cleaners, Shark is definitely one of my top favorites. The suctioning power lasts with this brand. The key is to clean your filters regularly. Especially if you live where you get a lot of dust in your home or if you have pets. We have two German Shepherds . My boys shed like a winter snowstorm all year round. We are very pleased with how well this picks up the hair.
I wasn’t expecting this vacuum to be smaller than the standard vacuum cleaner, and was considering returning it for the standard size. However it works so well that it didn’t make a difference. Actually I’m glad it’s smaller now since it makes cleaning the stairs easier. It seems to have a little bit better suction than the larger vacuum. I would have rated this a five except there is one thing that I don’t care for. When you use the hose attachment the vacuum cleaner tends to fall over very easily when using the tools. So I end up having to hold the vacuum steady with one hand while using the wand with the other. My other shark did the same thing. That’s my only complaint. Otherwise I a loyal customer to this brand. I also own the shark floor vacuum for downstairs and couldn’t be happier with it as well.
On a side note: My last Shark vacuum I had almost 5 years. The suctioning power was still very good till the end. The only reason we had to purchase another vacuum is because the canister lid broke by our own doing and could not be replaced due to the company no longer carrying it.
